rules.description: Aadhaar details of candidates must be verified directly with UIDAI during the application stage and not shared with Verifying Authorities.
rules.condition: When a candidate submits an application for the scholarship.
rules.outcome: The system verifies Aadhaar directly from UIDAI and the details are kept confidential from Verifying Authorities to prevent misuse.
rules.evidence_quote: Since, Aadhaar details of the candidate will be directly verified from UIDAI at application stage, the Aadhaar details of the applicants will not be shared with the Verifying Authorities to prevent accidental misuse.

rules.description: The portal must provide a checklist that the concerned authority must use for verification.
rules.condition: During the verification process performed by the concerned authority.
rules.outcome: Verification must be carried out against the checklist supplied by the portal.
rules.evidence_quote: A check list will also be provided by the Portal against which verification is required by the concerned authority.

rules.description: Verifying Authorities have three options available for conducting verification.
rules.condition: When a Verifying Authority is preparing to verify applications.
rules.outcome: The authority must choose one of the three defined options for verification.
